# European Journal of Educational Research (EU-JER)

> > EU-JER is a Scopus-indexed, peer-reviewed open-access journal publishing educational research with emphasis on STEM education, critical thinking, and pedagogical innovation.

The journal features contributions from international researchers exploring problem-based learning, environmental education, and evidence-based teaching methodologies. EU-JER maintains rigorous publication ethics standards and serves as a platform for advancing educational research globally.

## Key Topics

- Educational Research
- Scopus-indexed Journal
- Peer-reviewed Publishing
- STEM Education
- Problem-based Learning
- Critical Thinking Skills

- Academic Publishing Ethics
- Pedagogical Innovation
- Open Access Publishing
- Evidence-based Teaching
- International Educational Research
